[IDAT.3.3.2] **Reads borrow.** Every accessor that yields a
`const ds_json_t *` or `const char *` — `ds_json_get_string`,
`ds_json_array_at` / `_object_get` / `_object_at`, and
`ds_json_get_path` — returns a pointer INTO the source tree,
valid for that tree's lifetime and never freed by the caller.
